divisions.title: Prologue
divisions.summary: Job's righteousness, Satan's challenge, catastrophic loss, and the silence of friends.

divisions.title: Dialogues
divisions.summary: Job and his friends wrestle with innocent suffering. Each friend speaks, Job responds, and wisdom hides.

divisions.title: Elihu's Speeches
divisions.summary: Elihu, angry at both Job and his friends, prepares the way for God's answer.

divisions.title: God Speaks from the Whirlwind
divisions.summary: The LORD answers out of the storm, interrogating Job about creation, wild animals, and Leviathan.

divisions.title: Epilogue
divisions.summary: Job repents in dust and ashes, prays for his friends, and receives double.
